title: Ticket batch PAN-12 for the pantryline package
prompt: The package `pantryline` in the current directory has a batch of 25 change requests in TICKETS.md. Implement every ticket. Code must run on /usr/bin/python3 (Python 3.9), the interpreter the checks use; standard library only. tests/test_visible.py covers a couple of the tickets (`/usr/bin/python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`); other checks cover every ticket. Do not modify TICKETS.md or tests/test_visible.py.
